# Research Agenda

### Christian Vedel, Department of Economics, SDU

### Email: [christian-vs@sam.sdu.dk](mailto:christian-vs@sam.sdu.dk)

### `r Sys.Date()`


---
class: middle

.pull-left-wide[
# Christian Vedel

- Assistant Professor
- Defended PhD in Economics at SDU in 2023

> *I build machine learning tools and large-scale historical datasets to recover lost economic measurements from the past, and use them alongside causal inference methods to understand how geography and institutions shape prosperity.*

]

---
class: middle
# Two legs of the same agenda
(*A small selection of way too many projects*)

.pull-left[
### Questions about prosperity
*Causal inference × natural experiments × historical data*

- **.green[A Perfect Storm]** — a storm in 1825 reshapes northwest Denmark; 25% population growth within a generation
- **.green[Tracks to Modernity]** — how railway expansion shaped development and civic institutions
- **.blue[Creameries]** — how religion, energy shocks, and geography drove industrial productivity

]

.pull-right[
### Measurement infrastructure
*Building the tools to see history clearly*

- **.orange[OccCANINE]** — language model for occupational standardization; 14M+ records, 13 languages; rapidly becoming a field standard
- **.orange[CHAOS]** — converts occupational classifications into continuous income estimates
- **.orange[Copenhagen Income Project]** — reconstructs income distributions in 19th-century Denmark from records never before analyzed at scale

.small123[
**.orange[Data/methods] &nbsp; .green[Geography] &nbsp; .blue[Institutions]**
]
]
